descrizione_originale_completa: Service Health: You’re receiving this notification because one or more Azure subscriptions associated with your account use Microsoft Marketplace Windows Server 2022 images. You can also find this notification in the Azure portal under Service Health > Health advisories (https://aka.ms/AzureServiceHealthAdvisories) by using tracking ID 8PJS-_48.
